market.summary: A soft start is likely after yesterday's 0.6% fall: GIFT Nifty is about 75-85 points below Wednesday's Nifty close. Wall Street was mixed and hawkish: Fed minutes pointed to more rate hikes, the dollar hit a 19-month high, the Dow lost 1.1% and the S&P 500 slipped under its 200-day average, while the Nasdaq rose 0.4%. Brent is back above $92. The support is foreign money: FIIs bought a net ₹5,867 Cr on Wednesday, their seventh straight buying day, while DIIs sold.

points.text: GIFT Nifty traded near 25,152-25,155 early on 19 Nov, about 75-85 points under Nifty's 25,227.95 close, pointing to a weak open.
18 Nov US close: Dow 50,198 (-1.1%, about -560 points, UnitedHealth -10%), S&P 500 7,324 (-0.2%), Nasdaq 24,430 (+0.4%). Nvidia beat but fell nearly 3%.
Fed minutes showed nearly all officials expect further rate hikes may be needed; the US dollar reached a 19-month high and the S&P 500 closed below its 200-day average.
Asia this morning is mixed: Hang Seng -0.9%, Shanghai flat; the Nikkei was reported both slightly up and slightly down. Brent about $92.3-92.5 (+1%); rupee about ₹93.46 per dollar.
Provisional flows on 18 Nov: FIIs net bought ₹5,866.78 Cr, DIIs net sold ₹3,159.90 Cr; FIIs have bought for seven sessions, about ₹94,229 Cr net so far in November.
Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said the India-US trade agreement is nearly finalised; signing awaits clarity on the revised US tariff structure.

market.watch: Whether Nifty holds Wednesday's low (25,141.80) after a gap-down; the dollar and crude; a third day of midcap selling.

GROWW.summary: No new filing since last evening. The seller in the 17 Nov ₹1,905 Cr block at ₹219 was early backer Ribbit Capital (1.38% of the company); buyers included BlackRock, Kotak MF, Fidelity, Norges Bank and HDFC Life, so the supply went to long-term funds. Groww closed ₹223.52, above its 10 EMA (₹219.83); the trade is about +1.9R with the stop at cost. A weak market open is the near-term risk.

points.text: Ribbit Capital's two funds sold about 8.7 crore Groww shares at ₹219 (about ₹1,905 Cr, 1.38%) on 17 Nov; they held about 8.29% before. No lock-in or further sale plan was reported.

17 Nov block deals at ₹219: BlackRock Emerging Markets Fund bought about 53.6 lakh shares, BlackRock Global Funds EM Fund about 24 lakh, BlackRock India Fund about 17 lakh; BNP Paribas Arbitrage bought 36.5 lakh.
Capital-market stocks were weak: BSE Ltd fell 2.83% today.

GROWW.watch: A close below ₹219.83 (10 EMA, near the ₹219 block price) sells half; below ₹212.22 (20 EMA) the rest.
